title: Underage Possession or Consumption of Alcohol
grade_or_penalty: No criminal penalty: written warnings and referral to resources (as amended in 2021)
key_points: Persons under 21 who possess or consume alcohol in a public place or motor vehicle receive warnings; parents are notified on later warnings for those under 18.
Odor of alcohol alone does not justify a search; officers may not ask consent to search for this violation.
